move_tensors_to_device: move PyTorch tensors or a dict of tensors to a specified device and detach them
flatten_tensor_first_two_dims: flatten the first two dimensions of a tensor or dict of tensors into a single dimension
slice_tensor_along_dimension: slice a tensor or dict of tensors along a given dimension with start and end indices
create_one_hot_encoding: create a one-hot encoded tensor from a column of integer indices with a specified number of classes
set_random_seeds: set random seeds for Python, NumPy, and PyTorch (CPU and CUDA) for reproducible results
